content: Django behind Cloudflare Tunnel: set SECURE_PROXY_SSL_HEADER = ('HTTP_X_FORWARDED_PROTO','https') since Cloudflare sets X-Forwarded-Proto automatically; without it Django treats every request as insecure and can redirect-loop. ALLOWED_HOSTS must include the public hostname. CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS only needed for actual cross-origin POSTs (e.g. api subdomain posting to app subdomain) -- for a single-domain app it is usually unnecessary beyond matching the scheme. Enable SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT, SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE, CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE, SECURE_HSTS_SECONDS in production.
